claims.text: Unstable or cardiogenic shock WITHOUT LV outflow tract obstruction: inotropes.
claims.quote: Patients with more unstable hemodynamics or those who present in cardiogenic shock in the absence of left ventricular outflow obstruction should be treated with inotropes.

claims.text: catecholamine inotropes: 20% mortality reported (possible selection bias);
claims.quote: In TTS patients treated with catecholamine drugs a 20% mortality has been reported81; although this may represent a selection bias due to the initial presentation of the patients.

claims.text: levosimendan suggested as an alternative inotrope.
claims.quote: levosimendan could be used safely and effectively in TTS as an alternative inotrope to catecholamine agents.
